prompt:
Create a native Android app in Java named "Local Qwen AI".

Use OkHttp to connect with local Flask AI server.

Default API:
http://127.0.0.1:3333

Allow HTTP clear text traffic.

Flow:
POST /chat
Body:
{"prompt":"message"}

Receive:
{"job_id":"...","status":"processing"}

Then poll every 2 seconds:
GET /job/{job_id}

Show completed response, error, and busy status.

UI:
- Modern Material Design AI chat UI
- Gradient background
- Input box + Send button
- Loading state
- Disable send while processing
- No refresh

Settings:
- Change server URL (SharedPreferences)
- Add permanent AI System Instruction
- Combine system instruction + user message before sending

Use Java, OkHttp, SharedPreferences.
No Firebase, no PHP, no external AI API.
Add INTERNET permission and android:usesCleartextTraffic="true".
